overview.text: In a candidate debate, Castillo called immigration the district's biggest issue. In a 2024 Chicago Sun-Times questionnaire, she called for closing the border and implementing the 'Stay in Mexico' order, and she said migrants should be required to enter the country legally. Her campaign site says she supports no tax on tips and overtime, and no congressional pay during government shutdowns. According to an iVoterGuide questionnaire, she supports reducing taxes on income, fuel and death, and she believes federal funds should not go to abortion providers. She also supports school choice and voter ID laws, and she has a stated goal of protecting 'women’s sports and girl’s bathrooms.' On her 2024 campaign website, she stated she is a lifetime member of the National Rifle Association and Gun Owners of America. In 2024, she also expressed support for providing military aid to Israel and unwavering support for Ukraine.
